name: A_OPEN_TICKET
description: Open a ticket in RT / Jira ServiceDesk (design §4). Input: subject, body, optional queue. Stub-safe: when TICKET_API_URL or TICKET_API_TOKEN is unset, logs intent and returns a synthetic deterministic ticket id (DEMO-…) derived from the subject hash, so demo flows run offline. When configured, POSTs to RT REST 2.0 and a failed call fails the pipeline.
